meta.title: Literature workflow
meta.description: Arrange literature search, reading, Zotero classification, materials and publishing inside Harness.

title: Literature library
subtitle: Arrange search, reading, organization and publishing in a reviewable flow.
toolOnly: Automatic agent dispatch is unavailable. Use the literature_workflow tool in a Harness conversation.
workflowHelp: Drag cards to reorder them, or add a step below. Search and local import are separate entry points.
emptyFlow: Drop steps here or choose Add.
validationOK: Workflow is valid. Unreported source details will be marked for review.
validationError: The flow is missing a source or a required step.
searchDesc: A dedicated literature agent will collect candidates and continue through this flow.
queryPlaceholder: For example: digital finance and firm innovation, empirical studies from the last five years
uploadDesc: Choose or drop a PDF, Markdown (.md / .markdown), or paper.extract.json. Markdown enters your selected downstream steps directly and skips PDF conversion. Files use Harness’s authenticated local transport.
dropHint: Drop a PDF, Markdown file, or extract.json here
noJobs: No tasks yet. Start with search or local import.
hiddenJobsOnly: There are no visible tasks in the queue; {count} hidden tasks remain.
jobHidden: Task hidden from the queue view. This did not start or stop its workflow.
deleteJobNote: This permanently removes the task record, local outputs, and Zotero copies created by the task. The original paper files will be kept. Content already published to Blog or Tencent Docs will remain online. Review the deletion inventory below.
deleteJobDone: The task record and listed local outputs were permanently deleted.
deleteJobBlocked: This task cannot be deleted right now.
deletePreviewFailed: Could not load the deletion inventory. The task has not been deleted. Cancel and try again.
deletePreviewInvalid: The server did not return a valid deletion plan token. The task has not been deleted.
deleteInventoryMore: Showing the first 10 files; {count} more files are omitted.
deleteExternalNote: Content already published online will remain and is not deleted by this action.
stopAfterNone: Do not pause; run the rest of the flow
pausedAfter: Paused after “{stage}”. Choose Continue to resume the remaining steps.
promptApplied: Saved. Prompts apply to new tasks and do not rewrite completed output.
promptHelp: Add task-specific guidance while preserving the existing output format and evidence checks.
remainingNone: No unfinished step has an editable prompt.
remainingHelp: This only saves settings for this job’s unfinished steps; it does not start or rerun the task. Choose Continue when ready.
jobStopAfterNone: Do not pause again; finish the remaining steps
jobPromptSaved: Remaining-step settings saved. Choose Continue when ready.
agentProjectPending: {project} (not registered yet; created on first paper)
agentProjectHelp: New literature sessions appear under the selected Harness project and are named after the paper title. Existing sessions are not moved.
settingsNote: Credentials are sent by POST through Harness’s authenticated local route. They are never written to conversation commands or model prompts.
modelSelectionHelp: Applies only to this workflow. “Follow Harness default” uses the current default model.
unavailableSelectedModel: Saved model is not listed in the catalog: {model}
modelCatalogInvalid: Harness returned an unrecognized model catalog.
credentialsHint: Leave blank to keep saved credentials. The password is not shown in job cards.
authStarted: Authorization started. Refresh after completing it.
desc_import: Choose a PDF, Markdown (.md / .markdown), or an existing extract.
desc_search: Find candidates by topic, year and journal.
desc_download: Get an accessible PDF and retain its source.
desc_classify: Use the existing taxonomy and verify metadata.
desc_zotero: Deduplicate, create an item, and save the full-text attachment (PDF or Markdown).
desc_read: Read the paper and extract evidence in the 21-column format.
desc_excel: Create a workbook aligned with the source sheet.
desc_design: Create hypotheses, variables, models and identification materials.
desc_lecture: Create the full presentation and script.
desc_sheet: Append a record to the shared sheet.
emptyHint: Start with search or import above to create the first flow.
paletteEmpty: Every step is already in the flow.
tencentStarted: Opening the official Tencent authorization page. Progress updates automatically.
tencent_waiting_approval: Waiting for approval in Tencent Docs
tencentInstructions: Sign in and approve on the official Tencent page. No code entry or redirect is needed; the plugin checks and validates the connection.
tencentError: Authorization did not complete. Retry; if it persists, check the network and Python configuration.
tencent_error_timeout: Authorization timed out. Start again and use the newly opened page.
tencent_error_expired_token: This authorization code expired. Start authorization again.
tencent_error_access_denied: Authorization was denied in Tencent Docs. You can try again.
tencent_error_launch_failed: Unable to start authorization. Check the configured Python path.
tencent_error_network_or_local_error: Unable to complete authorization or save its result. Check the network and local write permissions.
zoteroAuthorizing: Click received. Contacting Zotero; check its authorization window. Remembered approval may complete immediately.
zoteroDenied: Zotero denied this request. Check Zotero before retrying.
zoteroIncomplete: Zotero returned no valid authorization. Check its window.
tencentRequesting: Click received. Starting Tencent Docs authorization.
zoteroTimeout: Zotero timed out. Open Zotero and check for a pending authorization prompt.
tencentBrowserFailed: The browser could not be opened automatically. Use the authorization link above.
tencent_error_vip_required: Tencent reported insufficient account permissions. Check the Tencent Docs account permissions.
tencent_error_token_validation_failed: An authorization result was received, but connection validation failed. It was not saved as connected.
